name: React
description: React is a UI library for building interactive interfaces from reusable components. This track starts with foundations and ends with a small project-style feature set.

snippets.title: Project Structure for a Learning React App
snippets.codeDes: Use a predictable structure so state logic, UI, and tests stay easy to find as your app grows.
snippets.code:
react-task-lab/
  src/
    components/
      TaskForm.jsx
      TaskList.jsx
      Pomodoro.jsx
    hooks/
      useLocalStorage.js
      usePomodoro.js
    state/
      tasksReducer.js
    App.jsx
    main.jsx
  tests/
    TaskList.test.jsx
  package.json

snippets.title: Create the Project with Vite
snippets.codeDes: Create, install dependencies, and start a modern React development server.
snippets.code:
npm create vite@latest react-task-lab -- --template react
cd react-task-lab
npm install
npm run dev

snippets.title: Task State with useReducer (src/state/tasksReducer.js)
snippets.codeDes: useReducer keeps task updates explicit and easier to scale than chained setState calls.

snippets.title: Task Form Component (src/components/TaskForm.jsx)
snippets.codeDes: Keep input state local and dispatch clean actions to your reducer.

snippets.title: Task List Component (src/components/TaskList.jsx)
snippets.codeDes: Render list state declaratively and keep actions near UI controls.

snippets.title: Persist Tasks with localStorage (src/hooks/useLocalStorage.js)
snippets.codeDes: A reusable hook keeps persistence logic out of UI components.

snippets.title: Compose the App (src/App.jsx)
snippets.codeDes: Wire reducer + persistence together, then render focused child components.

snippets.title: Mini Project: Pomodoro Hook (src/hooks/usePomodoro.js)
snippets.codeDes: Small project idea: build a focus timer. Start with a pure timing hook so UI stays simple.

snippets.title: Mini Project: Pomodoro UI (src/components/Pomodoro.jsx)
snippets.codeDes: Connect hook state to controls and keep formatting logic close to rendering.

snippets.title: Component Test with React Testing Library
snippets.codeDes: Start testing behavior by user interactions, not implementation details.

snippets.title: Next Learning Upgrades
snippets.codeDes: After the starter and mini project, level up with production patterns.
snippets.code:
1. Add routing with React Router for task views and settings.
2. Add optimistic UI when syncing tasks to an API.
3. Add accessibility checks (keyboard nav, aria labels).
4. Add form validation with zod + react-hook-form.
5. Add end-to-end tests with Playwright.
